company.name: Bunkerhill Health
company.shortDescription: Bunkerhill Health develops AI agents aimed at enhancing clinical and operational teams within health systems.
company.description: Bunkerhill Health develops artificial intelligence software and clinical workflow solutions for healthcare organizations. Its Carebricks platform enables health systems to create, deploy, and manage AI agents for clinical and operational use cases. The company also supports the validation, regulatory clearance, licensing, and implementation of AI algorithms to facilitate their adoption in clinical settings. In addition, it collaborates with healthcare providers and academic medical centers to evaluate and integrate AI technologies into patient care workflows. Its products and services focus on improving clinical decision-making, operational efficiency, and the deployment of artificial intelligence across health systems.

productsAndServices.description: An AI platform for health systems that interprets EHR, imaging, laboratory, and clinical-note data to identify risks, determine appropriate next steps, and automate follow-up workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Carebricks

productsAndServices.description: A conversational interface that lets clinicians query a patient’s longitudinal record and receive context-rich answers grounded in EHR data, imaging, laboratory results, notes, guidelines, and research.
productsAndServices.name: Carebricks Chat

productsAndServices.description: A portfolio of FDA-cleared algorithms that analyze routine medical images or ECGs to detect and quantify findings such as coronary calcium, valve calcification, low bone density, aortic enlargement, mitral annular calcification, and reduced ejection fraction.
productsAndServices.name: FDA-Cleared AI Imaging and Clinical Algorithms

productsAndServices.description: A service for health systems to configure and deploy AI agents for clinical and operational use cases, including finding patient cohorts, applying rules, and coordinating automated actions across specialties.
productsAndServices.name: Custom AI Workflow Design and Deployment

productsAndServices.description: A Carebricks-based registry service that identifies reportable cases, extracts and validates required data, prepares submissions, and triggers follow-up actions across oncology and other clinical registries.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Clinical Registry Management
